data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-l-l', meaning 'to be excellent, to select, to purify'. This name symbolizes the pursuit of excellence and perfection in all aspects of life, as encouraged by Islamic teachings. The name Kahlilia carries the meaning “Excellence, Perfection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kahlilia usually hope their child will grow to embody excellence, perfection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
